job.command: starver __STARVER__ # SCRATCH is allocated by SUMS on the worker, unlike the precreated output directory. if ( ! $?SCRATCH ) exit 80 if ( "$SCRATCH" == "" || "$SCRATCH" == "/" ) exit 80 if ( ! -d "$SCRATCH" || ! -w "$SCRATCH" ) exit 81 /bin/mkdir -p "$SCRATCH/__SCRATCH_SUBDIR__" if ( $status != 0 ) exit 82 if ( ! -w "$SCRATCH/__SCRATCH_SUBDIR__" ) exit 82 # Failed SUMS staging can leave a remote URI; reject nonlocal unreadable input. if ( ! -s "$FILELIST" ) exit 83 # SUMS may append an event-count column; both runners need path-only lines. awk 'NF {if ($1 ~ /^#/) next; if (NF>2) exit 1; if (NF==2) if ($2 !~ /^[0-9]+$/) exit 1; print $1}' "$FILELIST" > "$SCRATCH/production_input.list" if ( $status != 0 ) exit 83 setenv FILELIST "$SCRATCH/production_input.list" set input_count=`awk 'END {print NR}' "$FILELIST"` if ( "$input_count" == "0" ) exit 83 if ( $input_count > __FILES_PER_JOB__ ) exit 83 echo "Production input list (staged files):" cat "$FILELIST" foreach input_file (`cat "$FILELIST"`) if ( ! -r "$input_file" ) then echo "ERROR: input was not staged as a readable local file: $input_file" exit 84 endif end set runtime_dir="$SCRATCH/runtime_bundle" /bin/mkdir "$runtime_dir" if ( $status != 0 ) exit 85 foreach d (analysis config lib include StMaker StRoot) if ( ! -d "$d" ) exit 86 /bin/cp -RL "$d" "$runtime_dir/" if ( $status != 0 ) exit 86 end # Remove only scratch-local copied ACLiC products, not project originals. find "$runtime_dir/analysis" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*_C.*' -delete cd "$runtime_dir" if ( $status != 0 ) exit 87 setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ${runtime_dir}/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH} # Provenance the analysis cannot work out for itself: the runtime bundle is a copy, with no # git repository in it. Captured when this joblist was generated. Without these the tree # records no revision at all, which is what the 2026-09-15 farm pilot did. setenv STAR_ANA_GIT_REV "__GIT_REV__" setenv STAR_ANA_GIT_DIRTY "__GIT_DIRTY__" setenv STAR_ANA_LIBRARY_TAG "__STARVER__" singularity exec --pwd "$runtime_dir" -B "${SCRATCH}:${SCRATCH}" -B /cvmfs:/cvmfs -B /star/nfs4/AFS:/star/nfs4/AFS -B /home/starlib:/home/starlib --env LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$LD_LIBRARY_PATH" /cvmfs/singularity.opensciencegrid.org/star-bnl/star-sw:latest /bin/bash -lc 'set -eu; export ROOTSYS=/cvmfs/star.sdcc.bnl.gov/star-spack/spack/opt/spack/linux-rhel7-x86_64/gcc-4.8.5/root-5.34.38-eyawaunrtayjlt3aqon5claakm3c7xl7; export STAR=/star/nfs4/AFS/star/packages/__STARVER__; export STAR_HOST_SYS=sl73_x8664_gcc485; export STAR_LIB=${STAR}/.${STAR_HOST_SYS}/lib; export STAR_BIN=${STAR}/.${STAR_HOST_SYS}/bin; export PATH=${ROOTSYS}/bin:${STAR_BIN}:${STAR}/mgr:$PATH; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=${ROOTSYS}/lib:${STAR_LIB}:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH; root4star -q -b analysis/__RUN_MACRO__\(\"$FILELIST\",\"$SCRATCH/__SCRATCH_SUBDIR__/__OUTPUT_FILE_STEM___$JOBID.root\",\"$JOBID\",__MAX_EVENTS__,\"__MAINCONF__\"\)' set analysis_status=$status if ( $analysis_status != 0 ) exit $analysis_status if ( ! -s "$SCRATCH/__SCRATCH_SUBDIR__/__OUTPUT_FILE_STEM___$JOBID.root" ) then echo "ERROR: expected ROOT output missing or empty" exit 88 endif
